maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from IV solutions, consumable sets, connectors and pumps sold to hospitals; consumables and new devices, not aftermarket repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are hospitals and health systems paid largely by commercial insurers, patients and mixed payers; no majority government funding evident.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows via its own infusion, IV solutions and consumables products; Smiths Medical was one large deal, plus an Otsuka joint venture.

mission_critical.reason: Infusion pumps, IV safety software and Clave connectors are embedded in hospital workflows and EHR; switching needs retraining and requalification.
